definitions.explanation: A Western-style accommodation establishment. From English 'hotel.'

examples.japanese: ホテルを{予約|よやく}しましたか。
{駅前|えきまえ}のホテルに{泊|と}まりました。
examples.english: I stayed at the hotel in front of the station.

examples.japanese: このホテルは{高|たか}いですが、サービスがいいです。
examples.english: This hotel is expensive, but the service is good.

examples.japanese: {出張|しゅっちょう}のときは{会社|かいしゃ}の{近|ちか}くのビジネスホテルに{泊|と}まることが{多|おお}いです。
examples.english: When I'm on a business trip, I often stay at a business hotel near the office.

notes: ホテル refers to Western-style hotels with beds, as opposed to {旅館|りょかん} which are traditional Japanese inns with futons and tatami rooms. ビジネスホテル are budget-friendly hotels for business travelers.
